build_tool_call: build a normalized ToolCall object with id, name, arguments, and optional provider_data for any provider adapter
map_finish_reason: map a provider-specific finish reason string to a normalized stop reason using a custom mapping dictionary
create_ToolsCall_dataclass: create a ToolCall dataclass with id, name, arguments, and provider_data fields for cross-provider tool call normalization
create_NormalizedResponse_dataclass: create a NormalizedResponse dataclass with content, tool_calls, finish_reason, and provider_data for unified API responses
create_Usage_dataclass: create a Usage dataclass tracking prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, and cached_tokens from an API response
